output.summary: A palm tree native to northeastern Brazil, the carnaúba has a rounded crown of fan-shaped leaves and small black fruits. It may live for up to 200 years. Its leaves carry a natural coating harvested as carnauba wax.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit and pith are eaten; fruit makes jelly, dried pulp makes flour, seeds yield oil, and roasted fruit is brewed as a coffee substitute.
